comparison.objective: Uncap and spike an IV bag, then prime its drip chamber.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a sliding bag, pull a breakaway cap, align and force-insert a spike, then squeeze-release the chamber.
comparison.success_condition: Spike locked fully, chamber one-third to two-thirds full, bag remains on tray, hands release, and arms return.
comparison.reason: Forceful insertion and priming are different tested abilities from fine hex engagement, collar adjustment, relocking, and repeated impact evaluation.
